categories.zh: MCP 服务器与开发工具

zspace-cli.en: Agent Skill + zero-config CLI / SDK / MCP for ZSpace (极空间) NAS. No password, no SSH — plug in and manage your NAS.
zspace-cli.zh: 极空间 NAS 的 Agent Skill + 零配置 CLI / SDK / MCP——无需密码、无需 SSH,即插即用管理 NAS。

baidu-pan-skill.en: Agent Skill + zero-dependency scripts to download Baidu NetDisk (百度网盘) share links reliably: cookie extraction, transfer-save, resumable downloads, structural verification.
baidu-pan-skill.zh: 可靠下载百度网盘分享链接的 Agent Skill + 零依赖脚本:Cookie 提取、自动转存、断点续传、结构校验。

media-manager-skill.en: Media library naming scanner & organizer for local disks, cloud drives or any NAS (ZSpace, Synology, QNAP, UGREEN...). CN & Plex naming conventions, old→new preview before rename/move.
media-manager-skill.zh: 媒体库命名扫描与整理工具:支持本地磁盘、网盘与各类 NAS(极空间/群晖/威联通/绿联……),中英与 Plex 命名规范,重命名/移动前先预览。

media-naming-guide.en: Chinese media library naming conventions for Plex / Emby / Jellyfin, with a Cursor AI Skill.
media-naming-guide.zh: Plex / Emby / Jellyfin 中文媒体库命名规范,附 Cursor AI Skill。

shipit-skill.en: One-pass launch pipeline for developer tools: engineering baseline → publish → directory listings → promo.
shipit-skill.zh: 开发者工具一站式发布流水线:工程基线 → 发布 → 目录收录 → 推广。

agent-skills-cn.en: AI Agent 技能合集 for Chinese developers: token-frugal, security-first, lazy-dev, chinese-stack.
agent-skills-cn.zh: 面向中文开发者的 AI Agent 技能合集:token-frugal、security-first、lazy-dev、chinese-stack——让 AI 更懂中文开发者。

wheel-hub.en: Stop reinventing the wheel. MCP server + CLI that makes AI coding agents search GitHub for existing open-source solutions before implementing — scored 0–100 with adopt / adapt / inspect / avoid verdicts.
wheel-hub.zh: 别重复造轮子。MCP server + CLI,让 AI 编码代理在动手实现前先搜索 GitHub 现有开源方案——0–100 打分,给出 adopt / adapt / inspect / avoid 结论。

doc2md.en: MCP server: convert PDF / DOCX / PPTX / XLSX / EPUB / HTML & scanned docs to clean Markdown — URL-first, keyless, table-preserving, with OCR, split/merge and search.
doc2md.zh: MCP server:将 PDF / DOCX / PPTX / XLSX / EPUB / HTML 与扫描件转换为干净的 Markdown——URL 优先、免密钥、保留表格,支持 OCR、拆分/合并与搜索。

sops-vault-kit.en: Local-first, AI-manageable encrypted credential vault: sops + age + git, 30-command CLI, browser panel, TOTP, audit log, offline key cards, built-in AGENTS.md — one install.sh.
sops-vault-kit.zh: 本地优先、AI 可管理的加密凭据保险库:sops + age + git,30 条命令 CLI、浏览器面板、TOTP、审计、离线密钥卡、内置 AGENTS.md——一个 install.sh 装好。

ops-copilot.en: Self-hosted, self-healing ops. Alerts drive coding agents to fix their own bugs, gated by tests and human approval.
ops-copilot.zh: 自托管、自愈的运维系统:告警驱动编码代理修复自身 Bug,由测试与人工审批把关。

dsh-agent-token-stats.en: Cross-agent token usage dashboard: aggregates local logs of Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, DSH and more into a persistent ledger, with cache-hit, cost and drill-down analytics.
dsh-agent-token-stats.zh: 跨 Agent 的 token 用量看板:聚合 Claude Code、OpenCode、Cursor、DSH 等的本地日志为持久台账,提供缓存命中、成本与下钻分析。

dsh-plugin-sops-vault.en: sops + age + git credential vault as a sidebar panel — agents see structure only, plaintext flows only on human click.
dsh-plugin-sops-vault.zh: sops + age + git 凭据保险库侧边栏面板——代理只见结构,明文仅在人工点击时流动。

dsh-plugin-scaffold.en: Minimal runnable DSH plugin scaffold: one model-facing tool via `ctx.tools`.
dsh-plugin-scaffold.zh: 最小可运行的 DSH 插件脚手架:通过 `ctx.tools` 暴露一个面向模型的工具。

free-for-creators.en: 🎁 License-verified free assets for creators: 148 resources for music, SFX, footage, photos, fonts, icons, LUTs, mockups & 3D, each tagged with attribution and monetization rules. ([Browse →](https://skyzhao1223.github.io/free-for-creators/))
free-for-creators.zh: 🎁 许可透明的创作者免费素材清单:音乐、音效、视频素材、图片、字体、图标、LUT、样机与 3D 共 148 项,逐项标注署名与商用规则。([在线浏览 →](https://skyzhao1223.github.io/free-for-creators/))

geo-contacts.en: Geographic contacts PWA with family tree and friend presence.
geo-contacts.zh: 地理联系人 PWA:家谱与好友位置动态。
